question: The 10th Five-Year Plan aimed at reducing poverty by:
solution:
The correct answer is **5%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The 10th Five-Year Plan (2002-2007) aimed to reduce poverty by 5%.
 
• The plan emphasized inclusive** growth and sought to improve the living standards of the poor** and marginalized sections of society.
 
• It focused on enhancing employment opportunities and ensuring access to essential services like education and healthcare.
 
• The plan also aimed to** strengthen the rural economy and promote self-reliance **among disadvantaged groups.
